title: cochranea rugosa
intro: Cochranea rugosa, commonly known as the rough-leaved cochranea, is a plant species that belongs to the family Scrophulariaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in the treatment of various conditions like wounds and infections.
